section1.title: Information We Collect
section1.body: We collect information you provide directly to us when you create an account, log trades, or contact us for support. This includes your email address, account credentials, and any trade data you choose to enter into the platform.

section2.title: How We Use Your Information
section2.body: We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve our services, authenticate your account, and respond to your support requests. We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties for marketing purposes.

section3.title: Data Security
section3.body: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data. Your account is secured with authentication provided by Supabase, and all data is transmitted over encrypted HTTPS connections.

section4.title: Data Retention
section4.body: We retain your account data for as long as your account is active. You may request deletion of your account and associated data at any time by contacting us.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at support@phantomcipher.com.

section1.title: Acceptance of Terms
section1.body: By accessing or using Phantom Cipher, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our service.

section2.title: Use of Service
section2.body: Phantom Cipher is a trade journaling platform intended for personal use. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activity that occurs under your account.

section3.title: Disclaimer
section3.body: Phantom Cipher is a journaling tool only and does not constitute financial advice. Trade data you enter is for your own record-keeping purposes. We make no guarantees about the accuracy of calculations or results displayed by our tools.

section4.title: Limitation of Liability
section4.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Phantom Cipher and its operators shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the service.

info.title: What is the Trade Return Calculator?
info.intro: This calculator simulates the long-term outcome of a trading strategy using compound growth. Enter your key parameters and see how risk, reward, and win rate stack up across dozens or hundreds of trades.
info.item1Desc: The amount of capital you begin with. Every trade's profit or loss is calculated as a percentage of your running balance, so the starting figure sets the scale for the entire simulation.
info.item2Desc: How many trades to simulate. Compounding becomes more pronounced the further out you project — try 100 versus 400 to see the difference.
info.item3Desc: The percentage of your current balance you put at risk on each trade. Keeping this consistent is the foundation of position sizing and capital preservation.
info.item4Desc: How much you stand to gain relative to what you risk. A ratio of 3 means you target $3 for every $1 risked. Higher ratios can be profitable even with a lower win rate.
info.item5Desc: The percentage of trades that close in profit. This works together with your RR ratio to determine your real statistical edge — a 40% win rate with a 3:1 RR is still a positive expectancy system.
info.note: Results update automatically as you type. The chart and table are reshuffled randomly on every change so you can see how the sequence of wins and losses affects your equity curve — even when the overall statistics stay the same.
